title: Job vacancies at five-year low as smaller firms scale back recruitment
summary: UK job vacancies have fallen to a five-year low as small firms reduce hiring due to labour and operating cost pressures, according to the country's statistics body. This indicates cooling demand for workers and potential economic headwinds for the job market.
content: Small firms cite labour and operating costs as reasons for scaling back hiring, the UK's statistics body says.

zh.title: 小企业缩减招聘，英国职位空缺降至五年新低
zh.summary: 根据英国统计机构数据，由于劳动力和运营成本压力，小企业减少招聘，英国职位空缺已降至五年新低。这表明劳动力需求在降温，可能预示着就业市场面临经济逆风。

title: The 30-year Treasury yield just hit a 19-year high. Three things could drive it even higher
summary: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield has reached its highest level in 19 years, signaling potential shifts in borrowing costs and inflation expectations. Some strategists believe further increases are possible, which could impact mortgage rates and investment returns.
content: The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury has surged to its highest level in 19 years, and some strategists see scope for the move to go further.

zh.title: 30年期美债收益率创19年新高，三大因素可能推高
zh.summary: 美国30年期国债收益率已达19年最高水平，预示借贷成本和通胀预期的潜在变化。一些策略师认为收益率可能进一步上升，这将影响抵押贷款利率和投资回报。

title: South Korea must brace for ‘worst-case scenario,’ President Lee says, as Trump cuts military drills
summary: South Korea's President Lee warns of worst-case scenarios as the U.S. reduces annual defensive military exercises with South Korea following Trump's policy shift. This reduction raises concerns about the peninsula's security posture amid ongoing tensions with North Korea.
content: The annual exercises, are defensive and not intended to attack North Korea or raise tensions on the peninsula, Lee said.

zh.title: 特朗普削减军事演习，韩国总统李在明呼吁为最坏情况做好准备
zh.summary: 随着特朗普政策调整，美国减少了与韩国的年度防御性军事演习。韩国总统李在明对最坏情况发出警告，这一削减在朝鲜半岛持续紧张之际引发了对其安全态势的担忧。

title: Homeowner feared energy grant scheme was a scam
summary: A homeowner was cautious about an energy grant scheme, initially fearing it might be fraudulent. The program has proven successful in Cambridgeshire councils, which are now requesting additional government funding to expand it.
content: Councils in Cambridgeshire have asked the government for more money after the success of the scheme.

zh.title: 房主担心能源补助计划是诈骗
zh.summary: 一位房主对一项能源补助计划持谨慎态度，最初担心这可能是欺诈。该计划在剑桥郡的议会中已证明成功，这些议会现在要求政府提供额外资金以扩大该计划。

title: 'It was either feed my animals or feed myself'
summary: Pet food banks report declining donations during the summer months, as households struggle with rising costs and difficult financial choices. The decline reflects broader economic pressures affecting both pet owners and food assistance programs.
content: Pet food banks says donations of food have dipped over the summer.

zh.title: "要么喂饱我的动物，要么喂饱自己"
zh.summary: 宠物粮食银行报告称夏季期间捐款减少，因为家庭苦于成本上升和困难的财务选择。这种下降反映了影响宠物主人和食物援助项目的更广泛的经济压力。

title: Ship attacked in Hormuz Strait as U.S.-Iran ceasefire expiry risks prolonged conflict
summary: A ship was attacked in the Hormuz Strait, sustaining engine room damage and a crew casualty, as tensions rise following the expiration of a U.S.-Iran ceasefire. The incident highlights escalating risks to maritime commerce in a critical global shipping corridor.
content: The attack caused damage to the engine room and resulted in a crew casualty, UKMTO said, adding that the remaining crew were being assisted by the Omani Coast Guard.

zh.title: 船舶在霍尔木兹海峡遭攻击，美伊停火期满面临长期冲突风险
zh.summary: 一艘船在霍尔木兹海峡遭到攻击，机舱受损并有船员伤亡。随着美伊停火期满，紧张局势升级。该事件突显了全球关键航运走廊中海事商业面临的升级风险。

title: Commerzbank CEO Bettina Orlopp on leading a turnaround under takeover pressure
summary: Commerzbank CEO Bettina Orlopp discusses the bank's turnaround strategy amid UniCredit's takeover push, which has accelerated the company's strategic initiatives. Her leadership approach balances operational transformation with pressure from a potential acquisition.
content: CEO Bettina Orlopp discusses Commerzbank’s turnaround, her leadership philosophy and how UniCredit’s takeover push accelerated its strategy work.

zh.title: Commerzbank首席执行官贝蒂娜·奥洛普在收购压力下领导转型
zh.summary: Commerzbank首席执行官贝蒂娜·奥洛普讨论了该银行在UniCredit收购压力下的转型战略，这加速了公司的战略举措。她的领导方法在运营转型与潜在收购压力之间保持平衡。

title: Options investors are betting on this trend in gold prices, Susquehanna says
summary: Gold markets are experiencing muted volatility with strengthening upside potential and renewed investor inflows, according to analysis from Susquehanna. Options traders are positioning themselves to capitalize on this trend shift.
content: Gold is seeing muted volatility, firmer upside skew and renewed inflows.

zh.title: 期权投资者押注黄金价格趋势，Susquehanna公司表示
zh.summary: 根据Susquehanna的分析，黄金市场正经历温和波动，上升潜力增强，投资者流入增加。期权交易者正在布局以利用这一趋势转变。

title: Bitcoin is overdue for moves of 30% or more, Fundstrat says
summary: Fundstrat analysts predict Bitcoin could be positioned for a significant move of approximately 30% or more over the next two months. This forecast suggests potential major price volatility ahead for the cryptocurrency.
content: Bitcoin could be poised for a move of around 30% or more over the next two months, said Fundstrat.

zh.title: 比特币即将面临30%或更高的涨幅，Fundstrat表示
zh.summary: Fundstrat分析师预测比特币在接下来两个月内可能出现约30%或更高的重大涨幅。这一预测表明加密货币前方可能会经历重大的价格波动。

title: Disabled people in England to get 24-hour free bus travel
summary: England will provide 24-hour free bus travel for disabled people starting in April, a change welcomed by campaign groups. This expansion aims to improve mobility and independence for disabled individuals.
content: The change, which has been welcomed by campaign groups, will come into effect in England from April.

zh.title: 英格兰残疾人将获得24小时免费公交车出行
zh.summary: 英格兰将从4月开始为残疾人提供24小时免费公交车出行，这一举措得到了倡导团体的欢迎。这一扩展旨在改善残疾人的出行便利性和独立性。

title: US-Canada trade talks 'intense' as new tariff deadline looms
summary: US-Canada trade negotiations intensify as negotiators race to meet Trump's tariff deadline. Canada must convince the public to accept any concessions made during the talks.
content: Mark Carney will need to sell Canadians on any concessions made to the US as negotiators scramble to reach a deal to avoid Trump’s latest tariffs.

zh.title: 随着新关税截止日期逼近，美加贸易谈判"激烈"进行
zh.summary: 随着谈判代表争取赶上特朗普的关税截止日期，美加贸易谈判加剧。加拿大必须说服公众接受在谈判中做出的任何妥协。
